$comment: Starting palette (sRGB hex). The asset pipeline converts to OKLab for snapping. Bump styleVersion when the look changes.

direction.chosen: 10/08/2026, Stewart and the main agent, art direction v2
direction.notes: Retro 90s nostalgia on a modern 3D build: keep the 3D low-poly world (deformable terrain needs it), render it at reduced resolution with crisp nearest-neighbor upscaling, a limited warm palette with ordered dithering on shading and water, low-res nearest-filtered surface detail (pixel-noise sand, thatch, grass), pixel-style fire and spell VFX, warm firelight against cool dusk ambient, strong soft shadows. Small traditional tribal figures (no cartoon big-head proportions), the Shaper in feathers and hides with a carved staff (not a pointed wizard hat). HUD: a chunky stone and wood frame with round spell orbs (candidate 5). Avoid the glossy mobile-strategy look.

promptStyleSuffix: stylized low-poly game asset, crisp flat-shaded facets, chunky readable shapes, warm earthy palette, warm golden-hour lighting, clean silhouette, plain neutral background, no text, no logo
promptNegative: photorealistic, noisy texture, text, watermark, thin spindly parts, modern objects
